name: Abridge
description: Abridge is the Best in KLAS Ambient AI vendor for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), deployed at Mayo Clinic, Duke Health, Johns Hopkins, Kaiser Permanente, and 250+ health systems. The platform generates evidence-linked notes where each documentation element links back to the specific conversation that supports it—a transparency feature no competitor matches. With $800M+ in funding and deep Epic integration, Abridge has become the enterprise standard for academic medical centers. Pricing runs $400-700/provider/month for full deployment, with a new July 2026 'Unlimited Enterprise Agreement' site-license option. Behavioral health divisions inside Abridge-contracted health systems can access the platform, but solo mental health practices should use therapy-specific tools at 1/10th the cost.

seo.title: Abridge: Best in KLAS AI Scribe 2026 | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Abridge AI: Best in KLAS 2025-2026. $400-700/provider/mo. Evidence-linked notes at Mayo Clinic, Duke, Johns Hopkins. Enterprise only—not for solo practices.

faqs.q: How much does Abridge cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Abridge runs $400-700/provider/month for full enterprise deployment ($2,500-7,200/provider/year). A 200-physician health system should expect $1.4M-$1.9M annually before implementation costs. In July 2026, Abridge introduced an 'Unlimited Enterprise Agreement' site-license option that decouples pricing from headcount.

Psychiatry departments inside Abridge-contracted health systems can access the platform, but Abridge was not built specifically for behavioral health. It generates broad medical notes, not psychiatry-specific documentation with MSE structure or risk assessment fields. Solo psychiatrists should use Freed ($39-119/mo) instead.

faqs.q: What makes Abridge different from Nuance DAX?
faqs.a: Abridge's evidence linking is unique—each note element links to the exact conversation segment that supports it, enabling quality audit. Abridge is also Best in KLAS for two consecutive years (2025-2026). Both serve enterprise health systems at premium pricing; Abridge may be slightly lower cost than DAX's $600-800+/month range.

faqs.q: Does Abridge have a free trial?
faqs.a: No. Abridge is enterprise-only with no self-serve option. Health systems can arrange pilot programs (typically 3-6 months) through the sales process. There is no individual clinician signup.

faqs.q: Is Abridge worth it for mental health practices?
faqs.a: For most mental health practices, no. At $400-700/provider/month, Abridge costs 5-10x more than alternatives. Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) and Upheal ($69/mo) are built for therapy. Freed ($39-119/mo) works for psychiatry. Abridge makes sense only for behavioral health divisions inside large hospital systems already deploying Abridge enterprise-wide.
